Rooms.Name: Northwest end of Concourse
Rooms.Description:
You are at the concourse, the city wall is just west. A small promenade goes
east, and the bridge is just north of here. The concourse continues south along
the city wall.

Exits.Description: Wall road continues west of here.

Rooms.Name: Promenade
Rooms.Description:
The river gently flows west just north of here. The promenade continues
further east and to the west you see the city wall. Park Road leads south from
here.

Rooms.Name: Promenade
Rooms.Description:
The river gently flows west just north of here. The promenade continues both
east and west. South of here you see the entrance to the park, and a small
building seems to be just west of the entrance.

Rooms.Name: Promenade
Rooms.Description:
The river gently flows west just north of here. The promenade continues both
east and west. A small path leads south. Looking across the river you see the
levee.

Rooms.Name: Northeast end of Concourse
Rooms.Description:
You are at the Concourse. The city wall is just east and a small promenade
goes west. Looking across the river you see a building that resembles a
warehouse. The Concourse continues south along the city wall.  To the north
beyond large golden gates stands a huge green palace.

Exits.Description:
To the north stands a large school.  So large it blows your mind.  Which,
being a psionicists' school, is undoubtedly what was intended.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is built from large gray rocks that have been fastened to each other with
some kind of mortar.  It is far too high to climb.

Rooms.Name: Park Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are standing just inside the small park of Midgaard. To the north is the
promenade and a small path leads south into the park. To your east is the
famous Park Cafe.

Rooms.Name: Park Cafe
Rooms.Description:
You are inside Park Cafe, a very cozy place with many tables and seats where
you can relax and enjoy the view. To the east you can see the entrance to the
park.

Rooms.Name: Small path through the park
Rooms.Description:
You are walking along a small path through the park. The path continues
south and east.

Rooms.Name: Small path in the park
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small path inside the park. The park entrance is just
north of here, and Park Cafe is just east of the entrance. The path leads
further east and west.

Exits.Description: You see the northern park entrance.

Rooms.Name: Small path in the park
Rooms.Description:
You are on a small path running through the park. It continues west and
south and just north of here you see the southern wall of Park Cafe.

Rooms.Name: Cityguard Headquarters
Rooms.Description: You are inside a tidy office.

Rooms.Name: Park Road
Rooms.Description:
The road continues north and south. A building is just west of here, you
notice a sign on the door. The park entrance is to the east.

Exits.Description: You see the cityguard head quarters.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sign on the door says:-

                 Cityguard Head Quarters

           WARNING: Authorized Personnel Only!

Rooms.Name: Western Park Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the western end of the park. A small path leads east
into the park and going west through the entrance you will reach Park Road.

Rooms.Name: A path in the park
Rooms.Description:
You are in the park. The paths lead north and west. Westward is the park
entrance and to the east you see a small pond.

Exits.Description: You see the western park entrance.

Rooms.Name: The Pond
Rooms.Description:
You are swimming around in the pond, feeling rather stupid. You can get back
on the path from the eastern and western end of the pond.

Rooms.Name: A path in the park
Rooms.Description:
You are in the park. The paths lead north and east. Eastward is the park
entrance and to the west you see a small pond.

Rooms.Name: Eastern Park Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the eastern end of the park. A small path leads west
into the park. Going east through the entrance you will reach Emerald Avenue.

Rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the north end of Emerald Avenue. To the north is the
promenade and to the west is the park entrance. To the east is the not very big
Town Hall of Midgaard.

Rooms.Name: Park Road
Rooms.Description:
You are on Park Road which leads north and south. A cottage is just east of
here.

Exits.Description: You see a small cottage with an oaken door. A name plate has been set on it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The name 'Papi Llon' has been carved into the name plate.

Rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
Rooms.Description: You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue. The road leads north and west.

Rooms.Name: Road Crossing
Rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of the road cross. Roads lead in all directions. A
huge black iron chain as thick as a tree trunk is fastened into the ground at
the center of the road cross. Its other end leads directly upwards towards the
sky. A road sign is here.

Exits.Description: The chain disappears in the clouds.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The chain reaches the clouds high above you.  It must take some really
powerful magic to hold such a chain in place.

The sign points in all directions:

   North - Emerald Avenue.
   East  - Park Road.
   South - Emerald Avenue.
   West  - Park Road.

Someone has added the following with red paint:

   Up    - Redferne's Flying Citadel.

Rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
Rooms.Description: You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue. The road leads south and east.

Rooms.Name: Park Road
Rooms.Description:
You are on Park Road which leads south and north. Elm Street is east of
here.

Rooms.Name: Elm Street
Rooms.Description:
You are on Elm street. Park Road is to the west and Elm Street continues in
eastward direction.

Rooms.Name: End of Elm Street
Rooms.Description: You are at the end of Elm Street. An old elm tree grows here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fresh young leaves of the elm tree wave gently in the wind.

Rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
Rooms.Description:
You are on Emerald Avenue which continues north. The Concourse is south of
here.

Rooms.Name: Park Road
Rooms.Description:
You are on Park Road which continues north. The Concourse is south of here.
An old two-story house is to the east.

Exits.Description: A heavy oaken door is to the east.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at it, the goblin door knocker comes alive!

The head splutters 'Tiz iz da houze uff Kwiff...  Kuiffe...  Qwiff...  Erhm...'
The head splutters 'Quiff...  Quiffil...  Ne'er mind!  Quiffy livez ere!'

It opens its mouth wide and gobbles 'Unlokk me!'

The house is obviously very old and needs painting.  The heavy oaken door is
equipped with a brass door knocker shaped as a goblin's head.  No name plate
is to be seen anywhere.

Rooms.Name: On the Concourse
Rooms.Description:
You are at the southwest corner of the city wall. The Concourse leads both
north and east.

Rooms.Name: On the Concourse
Rooms.Description:
The Concourse continues both east and west. Emerald Avenue is north of here.
To the south you can leave midgaard through the south gate.

Rooms.Name: On the Concourse
Rooms.Description:
The Concourse continues both east and west. Park Road is north of here and
an iron grate leads south to the graveyard.

Exits.Description: Through the solid iron bars you see the graveyard.

Rooms.Name: On the Concourse
Rooms.Description:
You are at the southeast corner of the city wall. The Concourse leads both
north and west.

Rooms.Name: Park Road
Rooms.Description: You are at Park Road which continues north and south.

Rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
Rooms.Description:
You are at Emerald Avenue which continues north and south. Penny Lane leads
east from here.

Rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue. To the east the road goes on
and to the south is the Road Crossing.

Rooms.Name: Emerald Avenue
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at a bend on Emerald Avenue. To the west the road goes on
and to the north is the Road Crossing.

Rooms.Name: Park Road
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend on Park Road. To the north the road goes on and to the
east is the Road Crossing.

Rooms.Name: Park Road
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend on Park Road. To the south the road goes on and to the
west is the Road Crossing.

Rooms.Name: The Waiting Room
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the waiting room at the town hall. Wooden chairs stand
along the walls and a long desk with a typewriter is placed in the middle of
the room.

Exits.Description: It looks like some kind of office.
The exit west leads to Emerald Avenue.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is an ancient Quifatronic T-1000 mk I.  These machines are known for their
incredible durability, and for their even more incredible weight.  They make
a Cray II look like a laptop.

An extremely heavy desk.  It is so large that it doesn't even need drawers.
Everything can be stored on its top.
Not the very least comfortable.

Rooms.Name: The Mayor's Office
Rooms.Description:
You are in the not very big office of the Mayor of Midgaard. A large and
polished but completely empty desk is standing in front of an armchair that
looks so comfortable that it most of all resembles a bed with the head end
raised slightly.

Exits.Description: The waiting room is to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This chair is really a masterpiece.  A chair where one can sit as comfortably
as in a bed.  All auditoriums should be equipped with these things.  A shame
that there wouldn't be room for the students too, though.

This desk is obviously very old.  Nevertheless it looks as if has never been
used.

Rooms.Name: Penny Lane
Rooms.Description:
You are on Penny Lane. Emerald Avenue is to the west and Penny Lane
continues in eastward direction.

Rooms.Name: Penny Lane
Rooms.Description: You are on Penny Lane. The narrow road continues north and west.

Rooms.Name: End of Penny Lane
Rooms.Description: You are at the end of Penny Lane. The only exit appears to be south.

Mobs.Name: maid
Mobs.LongDescription: The Maid is waiting for your order.
Mobs.Description:
She is very beautiful with golden hair, and deep blue eyes.  A good reason
for coming here more often, you think to yourself.

Mobs.Name: sexton
Mobs.LongDescription: A Sexton is sitting here, drinking hot tea.
Mobs.Description: The Sexton looks like he is relaxing after another gravedigging job.

Mobs.Name: swan
Mobs.LongDescription: A swan is swimming around in the pond.
Mobs.Description: The white swan is very elegant.

Mobs.Name: duckling
Mobs.LongDescription: A duckling is swimming around in the pond.
Mobs.Description: The duckling is adorable, it looks most of all like a tiny furball.

Mobs.Name: sparrow
Mobs.LongDescription: A sparrow is flapping around on the ground.
Mobs.Description: The sparrow looks like it is enjoying life.

Mobs.Name: duck
Mobs.LongDescription: A duck is here, quacking happily.
Mobs.Description: The duck is quite fat.  It looks like it is enjoying life.

Mobs.Name: chief
Mobs.LongDescription: The Chief Guard is looking very upset.

Mobs.Name: cityguard guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A cityguard stands here, looking very upset.

Mobs.Name: secretary
Mobs.LongDescription: A secretary is sitting at the desk, typing away on the typewriter.
Mobs.Description:
She looks very busy.

>
The Secretary says 'Sorry, but the Mayor is extremely busy today.'
The Secretary says 'Please sit down and have a seat in the meantime.'

Mobs.Name: mayor
Mobs.LongDescription: The Mayor is sitting in his huge chair, snoring loudly.
Mobs.Description: He is a stocky, middle-aged man with thin, grey hair.

Mobs.Name: crier
Mobs.LongDescription: The Town Crier is here, weeping quietly.
Mobs.Description: He is very good at his job - completely dissolved in tears.

Mobs.Name: cityguard guard
Mobs.Description: A big, strong, helpful, trustworthy guard.

Mobs.Name: green gelatinous blob
Mobs.LongDescription: An oozing green gelatinous blob is here, sucking in bits of debris.
Mobs.Description: A horrid looking thing; it's huge, greenish, and looks like the blob.

Objects.Name: tea cup
Objects.Description: A cup has been set here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a small simple cup.

Objects.Name: coffee cup
Objects.Description: A cup has been set here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a small simple cup.

Objects.Name: water cup
Objects.Description: A cup has been set here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is a large simple cup.

Objects.Name: key iron
Objects.Description: An iron key has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The iron key is not special.  In fact, it's quite boring.

Objects.Name: key rusty
Objects.Description: A rusty key has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The key is a fairly large rusty key.  You notice a lot of dirt it.

Objects.Name: key wooden
Objects.Description: A wooden key has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wooden key is not special.  In fact it's just about the most boring key
you've ever seen in your life.

Objects.Name: key brass
Objects.Description: A brass key has been left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The brass key is small and looks like it fits a very complicated lock.

Objects.Name: desk drawer
Objects.Description: A desk is set against the western wall.
Objects.ActionDescription: The desk looks very sparse, there is a drawer in the left side.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You notice a keyhole in the drawer.

Objects.Name: safe
Objects.Description: A safe is placed in a dark corner of the room.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The safe is very heavy.

Objects.Name: gold coins
Objects.Description: A lot of gold is here.

Objects.Name: city key
Objects.Description: The very big City Key is lying here.
Objects.ActionDescription:
It is probably the biggest key you have seen in your life.  It is made from
polished gold and has various patterns on it along with the Midgaard Coat of
Arms.

Objects.Name: bench
Objects.Description: A white-painted wooden bench is standing here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a quite heavy but very comfortable bench.  It is placed with its front
towards the river so you can sit and watch the river and the houses on the
other side.

Objects.Name: fountain
Objects.Description: A small white fountain is standing here, gurgling happily.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is very nice.  Made from fine white marble.

Objects.Name: coins gold
Objects.ShortDescription: a small pile of gold coins
Objects.Description: A small pile of gold coins lies here.

Objects.Name: sword long
Objects.Description: A long sword has been left here.
